name: ECON 2102
title: Economic History of the United States
description: Issues in American economic development, including the political economy of the Constitution, the economics of slavery, the rise of modern corporations and the causes of the Great Depression. CA 1.
requirement_description: ECON 1200 or both ECON 1201 (or ARE 1150) and ECON 1202; ECON 1201 (or ARE 1150) may be taken concurrently.
